Dana: Quick sync — Velocita alpha hardware preview starts next Mon (2-week window). Need NDA signed, image build, and benchmark plan for marketplace listing. Who's owning what?

Kevin: I'll own the marketplace packaging (packaging artifacts, AMIs, listing copy). ETA Wed. Will need a small README for SI partners.

Maria Chen: Eng-ML — we need the Velocita driver/kernel bits. Is this a patched kernel or DKMS? We're blocked until we have the device plugin.

Jordan Park: Bench team — happy to run perf runs. New microbench script is here:
```
./rbench --target=velocita-X1 --model=gpt-medium --seq=1024 --concurrency=8 --profile=latency
```
Plan: baseline (stock driver) -> patched -> quantized runtime. Expect ~2 days per run.

Samir Patel: Legal — I'll send our standard NDA + data handling addendum. Partner already requested a logging/data-retention carve-out. I'll loop in privacy.

Dana: Good. Maria/Jordan — can we add a telemetry hook to capture token-level latency distributions and GPU counters? Need those for marketplace perf claims.

Maria Chen: Yes. We'll add a lightweight exporter (prom + metrics) and a small sample dashboard. Will post PR by Tue :white_check_mark:

Jordan Park: I'll wire bench-bot to run nightly suite against the alpha image. bench-bot, create job for veloci-alpha run next Tue.

bench-bot: Scheduled: veloci-alpha-nightly -> job id 202603. First run: 1976546000. Logs to https://internal.redwood/bench/logs/202603

Kevin: Also need a short runbook for SI integrators — install steps, kernel flags, known caveats. I'll draft.

Dana: Action items summary:
- Samir: send NDA + review partner carve-outs
- Kevin: marketplace artifacts + SI runbook
- Maria: driver exporter + PR
- Jordan: bench runs + analysis
- Dana: coordinate announcement timing, confirm partner ok with metrics copy

Please drop blockers here. :eyes:
